high_level_description: This image is a two-panel meme that humorously contrasts the idea of a hug making everything better with a dramatic twist. Top Panel: The setting is an outdoor scene with a clear blue sky and some clouds. A large, friendly-looking dinosaur is hugging a smaller dinosaur. The larger dinosaur has its arms wrapped around the smaller one in a comforting embrace. The text at the top reads, "ALWAYS REMEMBER THIS, A HUG MAKES EVERYTHING BETTER!" followed by a smiley face emoticon. The overall mood of this panel is warm and positive, emphasizing the comforting nature of hugs
